fullText.simplified:
雨中的美女

    周明已经在这个陌生的城市住了半年了。他还记得，十八岁生日过了不久，他带着一些衣服和考试用的书，从家乡一路坐着马车就来了。来这里的路有多远，周明说不清。但是，那摇来摇去的马车、忽明忽暗的阳光，还有马车里那些让人想睡觉的书，他永远都忘不了。
    周明想到，如果这次没考上，那自己应该怎么办？留在这个城市等下一次考试，还是又坐着那样的马车回到家乡呢？他的眼前又出现了父母充满期待的脸，这让他对自己的将来更加担心了。
    如果，自己没有生在这样一个读书人家就好了……周明慢慢呼出一口气。
    等了一会儿，雨开始小了，他看了看天，决定打着伞走回家。
    这条街上的人并不多，因为下雨，街边的商店里也看不到几个人。小雨好像一道天然的帘子，什么都变得模糊又陌生起来。
    他路过了书店、饭店，又转过了街角，到了下一条街。这条街看起来没有什么不一样，但是，他那颗心忽然开始飞快地跳了起来。
    远远地隔着雨帘，一个女子的身影落在了他的眼中。那绝对是一个美丽的女子，她非常年轻，穿着一条长裙。看起来像一朵雨中的花。
    她站在门边，手里拿着一本书。周明看不清她的眼睛是多么明亮，只见她久久地看着书，目光沉迷，一动也不动。周明真想告诉她：“别看了，什么书都没有你好看。”但她低着头，并没有发现这个呆呆站着的男人。
fullText.traditional:
雨中的美女

    周明已經在這個陌生的城市住了半年了。他還記得，十八歲生日過了不久，他帶著一些衣服和考試用的書，從家鄉一路坐著馬車就來了。來這裡的路有多遠，周明說不清。但是，那搖來搖去的馬車、忽明忽暗的陽光，還有馬車裡那些讓人想睡覺的書，他永遠都忘不了。
    周明想到，如果這次沒考上，那自己應該怎麼辦？留在這個城市等下一次考試，還是又坐著那樣的馬車回到家鄉呢？他的眼前又出現了父母充滿期待的臉，這讓他對自己的將來更加擔心了。
    如果，自己沒有生在這樣一個讀書人家就好了……周明慢慢呼出一口氣。
    等了一會兒，雨開始小了，他看了看天，決定打著傘走回家。
    這條街上的人並不多，因為下雨，街邊的商店裡也看不到幾個人。小雨好像一道天然的簾子，什麼都變得模糊又陌生起來。
    他路過了書店、飯店，又轉過了街角，到了下一條街。這條街看起來沒有什麼不一樣，但是，他那顆心忽然開始飛快地跳了起來。
    遠遠地隔著雨簾，一個女子的身影落在了他的眼中。那絕對是一個美麗的女子，她非常年輕，穿著一條長裙。看起來像一朵雨中的花。
    她站在門邊，手裡拿著一本書。周明看不清她的眼睛是多麼明亮，只見她久久地看著書，目光沉迷，一動也不動。周明真想告訴她：“別看了，什麼書都沒有你好看。”但她低著頭，並沒有發現這個呆呆站著的男人。

sentences.english: Zhou Ming had lived in this strange city for half a year.

sentences.simplified: 他还记得，十八岁生日过了不久，
sentences.traditional: 他還記得，十八歲生日過了不久，
sentences.pinyin: tā hái jì de shí bā suì shēng rì guò le bù jiǔ
sentences.english: He still remembered that not long after his 18th birthday, ..

sentences.simplified: 他带着一些衣服和考试用的书，从家乡一路坐着马车就来了。
sentences.traditional: 他帶著一些衣服和考試用的書，從家鄉一路坐著馬車就來了。
sentences.pinyin: tā dài zhe yì xiē yī fu hé kǎo shì yòng de shū cóng jiā xiāng yí lù zuò zhe mǎ chē jiù lái le
sentences.english: .. he took some clothes and books he needed for exams and took a carriage all the way from his hometown.

sentences.simplified: 来这里的路有多远，周明说不清。
sentences.traditional: 來這裡的路有多遠，周明說不清。
sentences.pinyin: lái zhè lǐ de lù yǒu duō yuǎn zhōu míng shuō bù qīng
sentences.english: Zhou Ming couldn’t say how far the journey here was.

sentences.simplified: 但是，那摇来摇去的马车、忽明忽暗的阳光，还有马车里那些让人想睡觉的书，他永远都忘不了。
sentences.traditional: 但是，那搖來搖去的馬車、忽明忽暗的陽光，還有馬車裡那些讓人想睡覺的書，他永遠都忘不了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì nà yáo lái yáo qù de mǎ chē hū míng hū àn de yáng guāng hái yǒu mǎ chē lǐ nà xiē ràng rén xiǎng shuì jiào de shū tā yǒng yuǎn dōu wàng bù liǎo
sentences.english: But he would never forget the swaying carriage, the flickering sunlight, and the sleep-inducing books in the carriage.

sentences.simplified: 周明想到，如果这次没考上，那自己应该怎么办？
sentences.traditional: 周明想到，如果這次沒考上，那自己應該怎麼辦？
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng xiǎng dào rú guǒ zhè cì méi kǎo shàng nà zì jǐ yīng gāi zěn me bàn
sentences.english: Zhou Ming thought, if he didn’t pass the exam this time, what should he do?

sentences.simplified: 留在这个城市等下一次考试，还是又坐着那样的马车回到家乡呢？
sentences.traditional: 留在這個城市等下一次考試，還是又坐著那樣的馬車回到家鄉呢？
sentences.pinyin: liú zài zhè ge chéng shì děng xià yí cì kǎo shì hái shi yòu zuò zhe nà yàng de mǎ chē huí dào jiā xiāng ne
sentences.english: Stay in this city and wait for the next exam, or go back to his hometown in a carriage just like this one?

sentences.simplified: 他的眼前又出现了父母充满期待的脸，这让他对自己的将来更加担心了。
sentences.traditional: 他的眼前又出現了父母充滿期待的臉，這讓他對自己的將來更加擔心了。
sentences.pinyin: tā de yǎn qián yòu chū xiàn le fù mǔ chōng mǎn qī dài de liǎn zhè ràng tā duì zì jǐ de jiāng lái gèng jiā dān xīn le
sentences.english: The expectant faces of his parents appeared before his eyes again, which made him even more worried about his future.

sentences.simplified: 如果，自己没有生在这样一个读书人家就好了……周明慢慢呼出一口气。
sentences.traditional: 如果，自己沒有生在這樣一個讀書人家就好了……周明慢慢呼出一口氣。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ zì jǐ méi yǒu shēng zài zhè yàng yí ge dú shū rén jiā jiù hǎo le zhōu míng màn man hū chū yì kǒu qì
sentences.english: It would have been better if I hadn’t been born into such a scholarly family … Zhou Ming exhaled slowly.

sentences.simplified: 等了一会儿，雨开始小了，
sentences.traditional: 等了一會兒，雨開始小了，
sentences.pinyin: děng le yí huì'r yǔ kāi shǐ xiǎo le
sentences.english: After waiting for a while, the rain started to lighten.

sentences.simplified: 他看了看天，决定打着伞走回家。
sentences.traditional: 他看了看天，決定打著傘走回家。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le kàn tiān jué dìng dǎ zhe sǎn zǒu huí jiā
sentences.english: He looked at the sky and decided to walk home holding his umbrella.

sentences.simplified: 这条街上的人并不多，因为下雨，街边的商店里也看不到几个人。
sentences.traditional: 這條街上的人並不多，因為下雨，街邊的商店裡也看不到幾個人。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiáo jiē shang de rén bìng bù duō yīn wèi xià yǔ jiē biān de shāng diàn lǐ yě kàn bú dào jǐ ge rén
sentences.english: There were not many people on the street. Because of the rain, there were not many people in the shops on the street.

sentences.simplified: 小雨好像一道天然的帘子，什么都变得模糊又陌生起来。
sentences.traditional: 小雨好像一道天然的簾子，什麼都變得模糊又陌生起來。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yǔ hǎo xiàng yí dào tiān rán de lián zi shén me dōu biàn de mó hu yòu mò shēng qǐ lái
sentences.english: The light drizzle was like a natural curtain, everything became fuzzy and unfamiliar.

sentences.simplified: 他路过了书店、饭店，又转过了街角，到了下一条街。
sentences.traditional: 他路過了書店、飯店，又轉過了街角，到了下一條街。
sentences.pinyin: tā lù guò le shū diàn fàn diàn yòu zhuǎn guò le jiē jiǎo dào le xià yì tiáo jiē
sentences.english: He passed by a bookstore and a restaurant then turned a corner to the next street.

sentences.simplified: 这条街看起来没有什么不一样，但是，他那颗心忽然开始飞快地跳了起来。
sentences.traditional: 這條街看起來沒有什麼不一樣，但是，他那顆心忽然開始飛快地跳了起來。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiáo jiē kàn qi lai méi yǒu shén me bù yí yàng dàn shì tā nà kē xīn hū rán kāi shǐ fēi kuài de tiào le qǐ lái
sentences.english: This street looked no different, but his heart suddenly began to jump quickly.

sentences.simplified: 远远地隔着雨帘，一个女子的身影落在了他的眼中。
sentences.traditional: 遠遠地隔著雨簾，一個女子的身影落在了他的眼中。
sentences.pinyin: yuǎn yuǎn de gé zhe yǔ lián yí ge nǚ zǐ de shēn yǐng luò zài le tā de yǎn zhōng
sentences.english: Far beyond the rain curtain, his gaze fell on the figure of a woman.

sentences.simplified: 那绝对是一个美丽的女子，她非常年轻，穿着一条长裙。看起来像一朵雨中的花。
sentences.traditional: 那絕對是一個美麗的女子，她非常年輕，穿著一條長裙。看起來像一朵雨中的花。
sentences.pinyin: nà jué duì shì yí ge měi lì de nǚ zǐ tā fēi cháng nián qīng chuān zhe yì tiáo cháng qún kàn qi lai xiàng yì duǒ yǔ zhōng de huā
sentences.english: It was definitely a beautiful woman, she was very young and wore a long skirt. She looked like a flower in the rain.

sentences.simplified: 她站在门边，手里拿着一本书。周明看不清她的眼睛是多么明亮，
sentences.traditional: 她站在門邊，手裡拿著一本書。周明看不清她的眼睛是多麼明亮，
sentences.pinyin: tā zhàn zài mén biān shǒu lǐ ná zhe yì běn shū zhōu míng kàn bù qīng tā de yǎn jing shì duō me míng liàng
sentences.english: She stood by a door, holding a book in her hand. Zhou Ming couldn’t see how bright her eyes were.

sentences.simplified: 只见她久久地看着书，目光沉迷，一动也不动。
sentences.traditional: 只見她久久地看著書，目光沉迷，一動也不動。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ jiàn tā jiǔ jiǔ de kàn zhe shū mù guāng chén mí yí dòng yě bú dòng
sentences.english: He watched her read the book for a long time, her eyes absorbed and motionless.

sentences.simplified: 周明真想告诉她：“别看了，什么书都没有你好看。”
sentences.traditional: 周明真想告訴她：“別看了，什麼書都沒有你好看。”
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng zhēn xiǎng gào su tā bié kàn le shén me shū dōu méi yǒu nǐ hǎo kàn
sentences.english: Zhou Ming really wanted to tell her, “Stop reading. No book looks as good as you.”

sentences.simplified: 但她低着头，并没有发现这个呆呆站着的男人。
sentences.traditional: 但她低著頭，並沒有發現這個呆呆站著的男人。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā dī zhe tóu bìng méi yǒu fā xiàn zhè ge dāi dāi zhàn zhe de nán rén
sentences.english: But her head was lowered, and she didn’t discover the man who was blankly standing there.

sentence_translations: A Beauty in the Rain
Zhou Ming had lived in this strange city for half a year.
He still remembered that not long after his 18th birthday, ..
.. he took some clothes and books he needed for exams and took a carriage all the way from his hometown.
Zhou Ming couldn’t say how far the journey here was.
But he would never forget the swaying carriage, the flickering sunlight, and the sleep-inducing books in the carriage.
Zhou Ming thought, if he didn’t pass the exam this time, what should he do?
Stay in this city and wait for the next exam, or go back to his hometown in a carriage just like this one?
The expectant faces of his parents appeared before his eyes again, which made him even more worried about his future.
It would have been better if I hadn’t been born into such a scholarly family … Zhou Ming exhaled slowly.
After waiting for a while, the rain started to lighten.
He looked at the sky and decided to walk home holding his umbrella.
There were not many people on the street. Because of the rain, there were not many people in the shops on the street.
The light drizzle was like a natural curtain, everything became fuzzy and unfamiliar.
He passed by a bookstore and a restaurant then turned a corner to the next street.
This street looked no different, but his heart suddenly began to jump quickly.
Far beyond the rain curtain, his gaze fell on the figure of a woman.
It was definitely a beautiful woman, she was very young and wore a long skirt. She looked like a flower in the rain.
She stood by a door, holding a book in her hand. Zhou Ming couldn’t see how bright her eyes were.
He watched her read the book for a long time, her eyes absorbed and motionless.
Zhou Ming really wanted to tell her, “Stop reading. No book looks as good as you.”
But her head was lowered, and she didn’t discover the man who was blankly standing there.
